parameter: reference adherence in the pooled trials
use_rule: Use multiplier = min(1; verified use share / reference); verified use = share of customer households with residual chlorine or product in use at an unannounced check; if use is not verified the multiplier is 1 and the confidence label drops one step
source_citation: Clasen TF et al. 2015. Cochrane Database Syst Rev CD004794
locator: Table: POU chlorination trial characteristics (12 cluster RCT compliance values measured by residual chlorine or self-report)
notes: Judgement call: the median of the 12 listed trial compliance values (32 to 90 percent) stands in for adherence embedded in the pooled RR

parameter: reference adherence in the pooled trials
use_rule: Use multiplier = min(1; verified use share / reference); verified use = share of filters in regular use at a spot check (for example weekly cleaning observed or water in the safe storage container); if use is not verified the multiplier is 1 and the confidence label drops one step
source_citation: Clasen TF et al. 2015. Cochrane Database Syst Rev CD004794
locator: Table: POU filtration trial characteristics (13 LMIC cluster RCT compliance values)
notes: Judgement call: the median of the 13 listed LMIC filter trial compliance values (13 to 100 percent)

parameter: reference adherence in the pooled trials
use_rule: No reference value derived; the verified use share is applied directly as the multiplier (conservative); if use is not verified the multiplier is 1 and the confidence label drops one step
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2022. Lancet 400:48-59 (adherence limitation noted in discussion)
notes: Evidence gap: trial adherence values for solar disinfection were not extracted

applies_to: household piped connection and community water point
parameter: reference use
use_rule: Use multiplier = share of connections or water points active (billed or metered or observed in use) in the reporting year; an inactive connection delivers no exposure change
source_citation: Definition of the output (an active connection is the exposure change)
notes: Enterprise-monitored input; no evidence row needed

parameter: reference use
use_rule: Use multiplier = share of installed toilets verified in use (observed signs of use or emptying records); the pooled RR already reflects partial use in trials so this is conservative; if use is not verified the multiplier is 1 and the confidence label drops one step
source_citation: Garn JV et al. 2017. Int J Hyg Environ Health 220:329-340 (latrine use increases averaged 13 percent in intervention studies)
notes: Judgement call: no trial-typical use value for sanitation hardware exists

parameter: reference use
use_rule: No use multiplier; the pooled RR already reflects suboptimal adherence to handwashing promotion; if the enterprise cannot show promotion contact the pathway carries no factor
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2022. Lancet 400:48-59

applies_to: point-of-use filtration and chlorination and solar disinfection
parameter: risk reduction retained from month 13 onward
use_rule: Decay multiplier on the risk reduction (1 minus RR) for every year after the first: year 1 = 1; years 2 and later = value; derived as (1 minus 0.69) divided by (1 minus 0.50) from F_POU_FILTER_LONGRUN and F_POU_FILTER_FROM_UNIMP; low and high from the CI of F_POU_FILTER_LONGRUN
source_citation: Mertens A et al. 2024. J Glob Health 14:04026 and Wolf J et al. 2022
notes: Judgement call: the filter value is a proxy for chlorination and solar disinfection (Cochrane 2015 found no chlorination effect in the two trials with follow-up over 12 months but gives no pooled value); flagged as proxy on those pathways

applies_to: toilet installation and sewer connection and container-based sanitation
parameter: risk reduction retained from month 25 onward
use_rule: No numeric decay available: sanitation interventions followed for 24 months or more showed smaller reductions (p = 0.005) but the size is not reported; years 3 and later keep the year-one value and the confidence label drops one step
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2022. Lancet 400:48-59

applies_to: household piped connection and community water point
parameter: risk reduction retained in later years
use_rule: No decay; the exposure change lasts while the connection is active; use ADJ_USE_CONNECTION per year instead
source_citation: WHO 2023 burden method applies constant relative risks to service levels

parameter: risk reduction retained in later years
use_rule: No numeric decay available; handwashing effects beyond the promotion period are not pooled; years after the promotion contact ends carry no factor
source_citation: Ejemot-Nwadiaro RI et al. 2021. Cochrane Database Syst Rev CD004265

applies_to: toilet installation and sewer connection and container-based sanitation
parameter: community coverage of at least basic sanitation after the installations
unit: share of households in the service area
use_rule: If coverage after the installations is at or above the threshold use F_SAN_BASIC_FROM_UNIMP and F_MORT_SAN_COMMUNITY; below it use F_SAN_BASIC_HHTARGET and F_MORT_SAN_HHTARGET and label very low; coverage comes from the enterprise service-area survey or else the JMP rural or urban value with a flag
source_citation: Sharma Waddington H et al. 2023. PLoS Med 20:e1004215 (no mortality effect where the majority of the community did not already use improved sanitation); Larsen DA et al. 2017. PLoS Negl Trop Dis 11:e0005591 (diarrhoea odds lower only at 100 percent community coverage)
locator: results text (sanitation threshold analysis) and Larsen Table 5
notes: Judgement call: the threshold value follows the wording majority in Sharma Waddington 2023; no study estimates a numeric threshold

parameter: mean duration of a diarrhoea episode in children under five assessed in the community
use_rule: Episodes per child-year = two-week prevalence x 365 / (14 + duration); applies to the DHS two-week prevalence baseline
source_citation: Lamberti LM et al. 2012. BMC Public Health 12:276
locator: results (duration of diarrhoeal episodes; weighted mean among community-assessed cases in LMICs)
notes: Mild episodes 4.3 days and severe 8.4 days; the community value is the one a two-week household recall captures

parameter: annual all-cause death rate per child-year under five from the under-five mortality rate
unit: share per year of the under-five mortality probability
use_rule: Deaths per child-year = (U5MR per 1000 live births / 1000) x value; an approximation for a stationary population where births are about one fifth of the under-five population
source_citation: Standard life-table relation; approximation documented in docs/methodology.qmd
notes: Judgement call: overstates the rate slightly in growing populations and ignores the concentration of deaths in the first year

parameter: conversion of an odds ratio to a relative risk at baseline risk p0
use_rule: RR = OR / (1 - p0 + p0 x OR); used for STH prevalence and for the direct mortality band where p0 is small so RR is close to OR
source_citation: Zhang J and Yu KF 1998. JAMA 280:1690-1691

parameter: relative risk of the WHO counterfactual level (safely managed water) versus unimproved
use_rule: Sum of exposure share x RR for the country = value / (1 - PAF_water); this normalises the country death and DALY rates to the risk at the unimproved level
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2023. Lancet 401:2060-2071 and WHO 2023 burden report Annex 1
locator: Table A1.1 of the WHO report; effect row F_WAT_PREMHQ_FROM_UNIMP

parameter: relative risk of the WHO counterfactual level (basic sanitation with sewer) versus unimproved
use_rule: Sum of exposure share x RR for the country = value / (1 - PAF_sanitation)
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2023. Lancet 401:2060-2071 and WHO 2023 burden report Annex 1
locator: Table A1.1 of the WHO report; effect row F_SAN_SEWER_FROM_UNIMP

parameter: relative risk of the WHO counterfactual level (handwashing with soap) versus no handwashing
use_rule: Sum of exposure share x RR for the country = value / (1 - PAF_hygiene)
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2023. Lancet 401:2060-2071 and WHO 2023 burden report Annex 1
locator: Table A1.1 of the WHO report; effect row F_HYG_HW_PROMOTION

applies_to: PAF route and scenario comparison for water
parameter: absolute relative risk by water service level versus unimproved
use_rule: surface water = 1; unimproved = 1; limited (improved more than 30 minutes) = 0.81; basic off premises = 0.81; improved on premises = 0.79; safely managed = 0.48; point-of-use product levels multiply the level RR by the product RR relative to that level
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2022. Lancet 400:48-59; WHO 2023 Fig. 8
notes: The product RRs in Wolf 2022 are multiplicative to within rounding (0.81 x 0.81 = 0.66 for chlorination; 0.81 x 0.61 = 0.49 for filtration)

applies_to: PAF route and scenario comparison for sanitation
parameter: absolute relative risk by sanitation service level versus unimproved
use_rule: open defecation = 1; unimproved = 1; limited (shared) = 1; basic without sewer = 0.79; basic with sewer = 0.53; safely managed on-site = 0.79 (no evidence of a further gain; flagged)
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2022. Lancet 400:48-59
notes: Evidence gap for safely managed on-site sanitation

applies_to: PAF route and scenario comparison for hygiene
parameter: absolute relative risk by hygiene level versus no handwashing
use_rule: no facility = 1; limited = 1; basic facility with soap and water (handwashing practised) = 0.70
source_citation: Wolf J et al. 2022. Lancet 400:48-59; Wolf 2023 adjusts facility presence for the probability of handwashing after faecal contact
